checks_actual_results: In the same published module #94, a two-row CSV import preview produced one valid CREATE and one IMPORT_TITLE_REQUIRED error and wrote no record before execution. Execution created record #188 while preserving the invalid row failure.

A published export configuration selected title, activity and owner; a CSV export of selected record #188 completed with exactly one row. Downloaded bytes were hashed and read unchanged in a separate JVM.

An invalid transfer target was rejected without changing #188. A newly role-scoped member then became its owner; the member could read #188 but received 403 for export. Actual Edge showed IMPORT/EXPORT in the owner runtime, the TRANSFER menu on #188, and the transferred record in the recipient runtime.
Attempted rollback of the import batch after the transfer returned ROLLBACK_PARTIAL with IMPORT_ROLLBACK_VERSION_CONFLICT; the newer record version and owner remained intact.

The existing print job #134 snapshot and PDF SHA-256, approval Flow instance #53 snapshot and current dashboard #8 stayed unchanged across import, export, transfer and rollback conflict. Backend #18082, started as a separate JVM against the same V23 database, read PDF/export bytes and owner back.
Python/Node syntax, workspace validation and scoped diff check passed. This packet changed verification tools and evidence; production code remained at the S18.33 Maven/Frontend tested version.
permission_or_failure_result: Invalid import title row was rejected; invalid owner target was rejected before transfer; the new owner with LIST/DETAIL but no EXPORT received 403 on export estimate; post-transfer import rollback recorded IMPORT_ROLLBACK_VERSION_CONFLICT and preserved the record.
